reviewer: Codex coordinator (not an independent human expert panel)
changeBasis: Only pre-evaluation taxonomy additions refine the existing independently derived methods. Original reference files remain unchanged; no model output has been observed.
methodology: Use the complete 37-case access cohort; score the 30 cases with usable real editorials. Expected methods/notes are evaluation-only and must never be supplied to the model. Not random: some contests overlap. Report access, adoption, needs-review, exact reference recall and adjudicated semantic precision separately. Count unique problem/tag pairs; duplicates never improve scores. Reference recall uses the union of all preregistered valid methods, including alternatives that may not appear in a particular fetched editorial, and is therefore not a claim of complete editorial-method recall. Additional legitimate tags require recorded coordinator evidence-based adjudication; preserve exact-reference and adjudicated metrics side by side. Generic/redundant ancestor suggestions are reported separately. Empty adoption cannot pass the >=90% precision gate.

cases.title: Dijkstra?
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement; methods derived independently
cases.reviewNote: Run heap-based Dijkstra on the nonnegative weighted graph; retain predecessor vertices to print a shortest path.

cases.title: Kefa and Park
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement; methods derived independently
cases.reviewNote: Traverse root-to-leaf paths carrying the consecutive-cat count. Reset at cat-free vertices, prune counts above m, and count reachable leaves.

cases.title: Boredom
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement; methods derived independently
cases.reviewNote: Aggregate each value's total score. The best score through value x is max(best[x-1], best[x-2]+x*frequency[x]).

cases.title: Books
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement; methods derived independently
cases.reviewNote: Positive durations permit a moving window with monotone endpoints. Alternatively binary-search the farthest endpoint in increasing prefix sums.

cases.title: Number of Ways
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement; methods derived independently
cases.reviewNote: If total is divisible by three, scan nonfinal cuts and count earlier prefix sums equal to total/3 when the current prefix equals twice that value. Update order matters when total is zero.

cases.title: Interesting drink
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement; methods derived independently
cases.reviewNote: Sort prices and upper-bound each budget; alternatively accumulate a frequency table over the bounded price range.

cases.title: Two Buttons
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement; methods derived independently
cases.reviewNote: Breadth-first search the positive states up to twice max(n,m). Alternatively work backward: halve even targets, increment odd targets, then subtract the remaining gap.

cases.title: Cut Ribbon
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement; methods derived independently
cases.reviewNote: Unbounded exact-length DP maximizes piece count with unreachable lengths marked invalid. A second method enumerates two piece counts and checks divisibility by the third length.

cases.title: Fence
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement; methods derived independently
cases.reviewNote: Evaluate every fixed-length window by prefix-sum subtraction or maintain its sum while adding the entering plank and removing the leaving plank.

cases.title: Fox And Names
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement; methods derived independently
cases.reviewNote: Compare adjacent names at their first differing letter to add precedence edges. Reject a longer word preceding its own prefix. A topological ordering must include all 26 letters.

cases.title: Greg and Graph
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement; methods derived independently
cases.reviewNote: Reverse deletions into vertex additions. For each new intermediate vertex, perform a full Floyd relaxation; sum distances only between currently active endpoints.

cases.title: Mike and Feet
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement; methods derived independently
cases.reviewNote: Find each value's maximal interval bounded by a smaller value. It can be the minimum for that interval length; propagate maxima from larger lengths down to smaller lengths.

cases.title: Sereja and Brackets
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement; methods derived independently
cases.reviewNote: Each segment stores matched pairs plus unmatched opens and closes. Merge by pairing the left opens with right closes; ordered range merges answer the subsequence length.

cases.title: Pashmak and Parmida's problem
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement; methods derived independently
cases.reviewNote: Compute occurrence counts in prefixes and suffixes. Sweep i while querying how many later suffix-count values are smaller than the current prefix count.

cases.title: XOR on Segment
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement; methods derived independently
cases.reviewNote: Store bit-one counts in each segment. XOR toggles selected counts to segmentLength-count; compose lazy masks by XOR and reconstruct the sum from the counts.

cases.title: Powerful array
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement; methods derived independently
cases.reviewNote: Sort offline range queries by endpoint blocks. Maintain frequencies and sum(value*frequency^2); each endpoint move adjusts the affected value's contribution.

cases.title: XOR and Favorite Number
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement; methods derived independently
cases.reviewNote: Convert subarray XOR into pairs of prefix-XOR values on [l-1,r]. Mo's algorithm maintains frequencies; insertion/removal updates the number of pairs differing by k.

cases.title: Lomsat gelral
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement; methods derived independently
cases.reviewNote: Merge subtree color-frequency maps from smaller into larger, maintaining maximum frequency and sum of colors attaining it. A DSU-on-tree traversal offers another implementation.

cases.title: Fools and Roads
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement; methods derived independently
cases.reviewNote: For each path add one at both endpoints and subtract two at their LCA. Sum differences upward; each child's accumulated value is the count for its parent edge.

cases.title: The Child and Sequence
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement; methods derived independently
cases.reviewNote: Store segment sum and maximum. A modulo update skips segments whose maximum is below the modulus and descends otherwise. Effective modulo reductions at least halve values; point assignments account for new potential.

cases.title: Password
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement; methods derived independently
cases.reviewNote: Use prefix-function border links and an internal occurrence check, or a Z-function scan. Exclude the single suffix occurrence when requiring an occurrence strictly inside the string.

cases.title: Prefixes and Suffixes
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement; methods derived independently
cases.reviewNote: Accumulate prefix occurrence counts along failure links, then enumerate borders. Alternatively count how many Z-values reach each border length.

cases.title: Good Substrings
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement; methods derived independently
cases.reviewNote: Enumerate substring starts and extend while the number of bad letters is within k. Count newly created trie nodes for exact distinctness, or use verified/collision-aware substring hashing.

cases.title: Longest Regular Bracket Sequence
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement; methods derived independently
cases.reviewNote: Track the longest valid substring ending at each position with DP, or maintain unmatched bracket indices on a stack with a sentinel. Count maximal-length endings, with the required 0 1 empty case.

cases.title: Checkposts
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement; methods derived independently
cases.reviewNote: Find strongly connected components. Choose a minimum-cost vertex in each; add those minima and multiply their multiplicities modulo 1e9+7.

cases.title: Minimum spanning tree for each edge
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement; methods derived independently
cases.reviewNote: Build an MST by Kruskal. For each required edge, replace the maximum-weight edge on the corresponding MST path; binary-lifting path maxima give efficient queries. MST and sorting have dedicated nodes in taxonomy 2026.09.2.

cases.title: 【模板】树状数组 1
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement; methods derived independently
cases.reviewNote: Support point additions and range sums with a Fenwick tree (two prefix queries), or a segment tree.

cases.title: 【模板】并查集
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement; methods derived independently
cases.reviewNote: Use disjoint-set representatives, path compression and union by size to process merges and membership queries.

cases.title: 【模板】线段树 1
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement; methods derived independently
cases.reviewNote: Maintain range-add lazy tags and segment sums. An alternative uses two Fenwick trees for range-add/range-sum formulas; results require a wide integer representation.

cases.title: 【模板】线性筛素数
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement; methods derived independently
cases.reviewNote: Precompute primes through n with an Euler linear sieve or an Eratosthenes sieve, then answer kth-prime queries from the ordered prime list.

cases.title: Kefa and First Steps
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement and independently derived valid methods before model benchmark
cases.reviewNote: Track the current nondecreasing run length, reset on a drop, and retain its maximum. This also admits a one-dimensional recurrence.

cases.title: Kefa and Company
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement and independently derived valid methods before model benchmark
cases.reviewNote: Sort friends by money, keep a window whose endpoint difference is strictly below d, and maximize its friendship sum. A prefix-sum plus binary-search variant is valid. Sorting is represented in taxonomy 2026.09.2.

cases.title: Kefa and Dishes
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement and independently derived valid methods before model benchmark
cases.reviewNote: Use a visited-dish mask and final dish as the DP state; append an unused dish with its base satisfaction and adjacency bonus. Only states with m selected dishes are answers.

cases.title: Kefa and Watch
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement and independently derived valid methods before model benchmark
cases.reviewNote: A substring has period d when its prefix and suffix shifted by d agree. Maintain normalized polynomial hashes under range digit assignment using a lazy segment tree. Hash collision handling is an implementation concern.

cases.title: Laptops
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement and independently derived valid methods before model benchmark
cases.reviewNote: Both prices and qualities are permutations of 1..n. If all paired values agree no inversion exists; otherwise an inversion must occur. Sorting followed by an inversion check is another valid method; sorting has a dedicated node in taxonomy 2026.09.2.

cases.title: Fedya and Maths
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement and independently derived valid methods before model benchmark
cases.reviewNote: The residue of the sum of the four powers depends on the decimal exponent modulo 4; stream the digits to compute that residue. Modular exponentiation by decimal digits is an alternative. Modular exponentiation is represented in taxonomy 2026.09.2.

cases.title: Beru-taxi
cases.reviewBasis: coordinator inspected official statement and independently derived valid methods before model benchmark
cases.reviewNote: Compute Euclidean distance divided by speed for each available taxi, then take the minimum; no routing algorithm is needed.
